messages:
jordana: Quick thread — proposal to add an explicit `response_tier` both in HTTP headers and JSON body so clients (and console) can surface unified UX across fallback/quotas/terminal errors. :thinking:
alex: Can you sketch values? soft/retryable/terminal/quota? How do they map to HTTP status buckets?
jordana: Yeah, thinking: `soft` = degraded but successful response (200 with warning), `retryable` = transient failure (502/503 + `retry_after`), `quota` = rate limited (429 + quota headers), `terminal` = user error or invalid request (4xx) but also some model-level terminal states.
sam: Runtime + SDK note — we should prefer header `x-rw-response-tier` for quick routing in proxies. Body can include `response_tier` for clients that parse JSON.
kai: Telemetry: we need a consistent tag for each request `response.tier` so dashboards can roll up. Also add `response.tier_reason` for breakdowns.
maria: Console copy: we don't want developer confusion when they see 'soft' badge. Suggest labels: "Degraded (soft)", "Retryable (transient)", "Rate limit", "Terminal" — and short hover copy explaining recommended action.
tanvi: UX question — for `soft` should we still increment error budgets? My vote: no, treat as warn-only, but surface in SLA timelines. For SLO alerts, only `retryable` + `terminal` count.
alex: Compatibility: older SDKs will treat non-2xx as errors. For `soft` we must keep 200. For `retryable` we keep 5xx semantics. Also add `x-rw-retryable: true`? Prefer single header `x-rw-response-tier` to avoid header sprawl.
jordana: Agreed. Draft response example:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-RW-Response-Tier: soft
{
  "data": [...],
  "warning": "model degraded: fallback used",
  "response_tier": "soft"
}
```
sam: For SDKs we'll add mapping: map `response_tier` -> SDK Error classes (SoftWarning, TransientError, TerminalError, QuotaError) and console badges.
kai: Rollout plan: start with internal alpha, tag `response.tier` in telemetry for 2 weeks, then enable console badging for 5% of orgs, measure: change in client retries, alerts, and support tickets.
maria: Copy suggestions for console badge hover: "Degraded: A lower-quality model or fallback was used. No action required but expect different outputs." Keep copy <120 chars.
tanvi: Suggest also exposing `retry_after` for `retryable`, and `quota_reset` for `quota` so apps can backoff gracefully.
jordana: OK action items: (1) alex/sam implement header + body field + SDK mapping PR; (2) kai add telemetry tags + dashboard; (3) maria draft console copy variants; (4) rollout-bot schedule canary for 5% on 2026-04-05. Any objections?
alex: no objections, will open PR today. :thumbsup:
sam: I'll stub SDK changes and tests.
kai: I'll add dashboard panels and alerts.
maria: I'll put copy variants into the docs PR.
rollout-bot: scheduled canary: 2026-04-05T10:00:00Z -> 5% orgs. :white_check_mark:
